title: Sign-in (username, password, OTP)
summary: Three steps against two main endpoints. The username check decides whether the user goes to the password screen or the activation screen. The same login endpoint serves password sign-in and OTP verification; only `method`, `password` and `otp` differ.
notes: `checkUser` has no path annotation: it takes a `@Url`. `defpackage/C0571Dj.java:638-647` builds `<central base> + v1/user/check-username`. The response carries `api_url` and `portal_url`, which switch the base URL for every later call (`defpackage/C6567tj.java:115-139`, falling back to `https://api.beatroute.io/`).
Password screen sends `method=password`, `password` set, `otp=""`. OTP screen sends `method=otp`, `otp=<code>`, `password=""`, `terms_accepted="1"`.
Branching after the username check: empty `name` shows an error; otherwise password screen, or activation if the account is not activated and has no password.
The splash screen reuses `DBManager.login` for silent token re-login (`SplashScreen.java:450`).
open: Auth scheme for later calls (token header) was not traced.
Whether the server accepts the Jackson name `deviceInfo` as well as `device_model`.

title: Customer (retailer) list and detail
summary: The list is offline-first: the response is saved to the local SQLite copy and the screen mostly reads that copy. Detail is a single GET by id and is shared by about 20 screens.
notes: Detail call chain: `DBManagerKotlin.Companion.H2` -> `viewRetailer$1` -> `ApiInterfaceKotlin.getViewRetailer` (`ApiInterfaceKotlin.java:701-702`). `H2` is called by `CreditDebitDetail`, `PaymentDetailScreen`, `DispatchDetail`, `DraftOrderListActivity` and others.
`Retailer` (about 100 fields) mixes API fields with client-only state (`isSelected`, `islongPressed`, `isError`, `errorMessage`, `latitudeCapturedOnList`). Treat those as not part of the API.
open: How `RetailersActivity` hands over to `ItemFragment` was not confirmed.

title: Take order and submit order
summary: Products and schemes are read with GETs. The order itself is not posted by the screen: it is queued locally and `ActivitySyncService` posts it, so the write path starts at the queue.
notes: Write path: `service/ActivitySyncService.java:1599` -> `DBManager.submitOrder` (`DBManager.java:16011`) -> `C0571Dj.n1` (`C0571Dj.java:657`) -> `ApiInterface.submitOrder`. It posts any queued `Order` task marked syncing and not in error.
Fixed header values set by the client: `status="New"`, `source="Mobile"`. Images go as base64 JPEG in `image_binary` and `signature_image_binary`.

The header has one field `hasreturns` but two boolean accessors, `isHasReturns` and `isHasreturns`, so Jackson would send both `hasReturns` and `hasreturns`. The server name `locationAcuuracy` is spelled that way in the source (sic).
Tax-inclusive price, tax and scheme price are computed on the client before the call (`DBManager.java:16143-16178`).
The product screen is `takeOrder/ProductListViewKotlin` with `takeOrder/ProductViewModel`, which is partly undecompiled (see RECON.md).
open: The hop from the order screen to the local queue (the Order insert) was not traced.
Which SKU endpoint the product list actually calls: `v1/sku/price` is the likely one, `v1/sku/index` exists on the Ktor side.
